Content: MemorySmith chat is provider-based. IChatProvider isolates model API calls and IChatAgent isolates memory/page context gathering and agent-write behavior. OllamaChatProvider is the current local provider using /api/chat on the configured Ollama endpoint and model. MemoryChatAgent builds context from hybrid memory search plus markdown page search. Chat mode answers questions; Agent mode can parse structured provider output and write MemoryRecord entries and Data/Pages markdown pages when Chat:AgentWritesEnabled is true. The design leaves room for OpenAI, Copilot, Anthropic, or other providers without changing the UI.
Title: Chat Agent Provider Architecture
